messages:
tori: ops asked for a 'fastpath' button in the tenant console to immediately switch traffic to a safe model. they want 1-click. tradeoffs?
ben: immediate nope on long-lived keys. ephemeral only, please.
akash: agree. tech sketch: mint an ephemeral token via /tokens/mint with claim fastpath:true, ttl=300s, include audit_id in response. router uses claim to apply fastpath policy.
maya: important: quota attribution must remain to original_project. we can tag events with fastpath=true so finance can reconcile. also require hard RPS ceiling for any fastpath actions.
tori: ops also wants optional traffic-split toggles (0-100%). risky but useful in P0. require explicit checkbox and record previous split.
ben: UX must require typing tenant name, SSO+2FA, and select two approvers for prod tenants. do not render raw key after creation.
akash: router change: when claim fastpath true, add header x-rwd-fastpath=audit_id and tag telemetry with origin_project and override_reason=fastpath. enforce ceiling server-side.
maya: telemetry: counter(fastpath_activations), gauge(active_fastpath_tokens), histogram(duration_of_fastpath), and alert if >2 activations in 1h per tenant.
ops-bot: policy sketch: mint_ephemeral { ttl: 300s, require_approvals: 2, audit_label: tenant_fastpath, hard_cap_enforced: true }
ben: security note: approver cannot be requester, log IP/device, persist events to immutable audit store.
tori: rollout plan: behind ff 'console-fastpath', internal-only first, 2 week telemetry trial, threat model review before wider enable.
akash: i'll scope backend + router changes and open a PR.
maya: i'll mock the modal copy and the audit table view.
ops-bot: created issue #9200 by tori: https://rwd/gh/9200 'console fastpath prototype: ephemeral tokens, audit + ceilings'
